name: Devices
description: The battery of your AirPods, mouse, keyboard and other Bluetooth devices.
author: Giuseppe
details: The battery of everything Bluetooth, in one place. The button shows the lowest one, colored by how low it is; open it for AirPods (each earbud and the case), the mouse, the keyboard, the trackpad and the controller.
features: Read in the background, never slows the notch
permissions: Reads the Bluetooth report from macOS. No permission needed.
